entrypoints.summary: Windows callers supplying path strings to filepath.Clean or filepath.Join can cause normalization of path elements containing the \??\ prefix.
Affected Windows path/filepath API scope includes Clean, Join, IsAbs, VolumeName, and other listed symbols; internal/safefilepath FromFS is also listed.

sources.concept: attacker-influenced Windows path components passed to filepath normalization

impact.affected_asset: Windows filesystem locations reachable through the resulting path, subject to the consuming application's use of the path and operating-system permissions.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a consuming application that passes attacker-influenced path strings to the affected filepath APIs to receive a Root Local Device path rather than the expected non-device relative form.
impact.security_effect: Path normalization can produce a Windows Root Local Device path that may access arbitrary locations on the system.

causal_trace.summary: A caller supplies a Windows rooted path whose elements include \??\, such as \a\..\??\b, or supplies Join elements (\, ??, b).
The path/filepath parser does not recognize \??\ as the Root Local Device prefix, although Windows treats it equivalently to \\?\ and as a volume/absolute-path form.
Clean or Join normalizes the supplied components into \??\b rather than retaining a relative .\??\b or \.\??\b form, thereby constructing a Root Local Device path.
The resulting Root Local Device path can designate arbitrary system locations; for example, \??\c:\x is equivalent to c:\x.

failure.operation: filepath.Clean and filepath.Join construct a Root Local Device path from inputs containing an unrecognized \??\ component

primary_invariant.statement: Windows paths beginning with \??\ must be recognized as Root Local Device absolute paths with a volume prefix, and normalization must not synthesize that device-path form from rooted or separately joined ordinary-looking components.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Before the fix, filepath did not treat \??\ as special, so Clean and Join could create \??\b from the documented inputs; IsAbs and VolumeName also failed to classify the prefix correctly.

quality.review_notes: The reviewed advisory and issue provide concrete input-to-output normalization behavior and version scope. Patch artifacts are present but their materialized excerpts are empty, so this record does not assert specific source edits, test names, or test execution. The follow-up range reflects a compatibility regression in Windows \\?\ volume handling, not a claim that the original \??\ mechanism recurred.

remediation.invariant_restored: Clean converts \a\..\??\b to .\??\b, Join(\, ??, b) to \.\??\b, IsAbs recognizes \??\ paths as absolute, and VolumeName reports the \??\ prefix.
mitigation_classes: recognize Root Local Device prefixes during Windows path parsing
preserve non-device relative form when Clean or Join encounters the documented \??\ component sequence
classify \??\ paths as absolute and expose the prefix as a volume name
